verdict.rationale: Morph's own docs say it serves open-weight models through OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic Messages endpoints, and that you can run Claude Code against them and migrate a production agent onto Kimi K3. That implies agent loops with tool calls work on its open models, but tool calling is never documented explicitly. The edit_file and MCP tools are tools Morph provides, not evidence of the models' tool-calling fidelity, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of function/tool-calling support (tools/tool_choice schema), parallel tool calls, multi-step tool-use reliability or benchmarks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
